task.name: Clean_event_stage
task.when: After the Sound Lead releases the stage for cleanup

step.action: Put unattended personal belongings in 🍷 Lost_and_Found.
Return non-sound camp equipment to its storage place.
Put trash and MOOP in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Inspect the stage floor and edges for remaining objects.

passWhen.criterion: No unattended belonging, unrelated equipment, trash, or MOOP remains on the stage.
